messages.content: Independent enterprise rubric for exact predeployment SHA 5efaab0c4c6239c2c2586b756c64e245d01cb0c6. P if evidence is sufficient and no concrete material defect exists. UI-only changes are acceptable. Deployment proof is not required until the release node. Emit schema JSON only.

V4 changes only client UI/CSS and Guided orchestration: autosave persists DRAFT before preview; approve and launch remain separate explicit server actions unchanged. Real media cards consume existing authenticated artifact URLs. No auth, persistence, provider, dependencies, Docker, Compose, deployment control plane or trust roots changed. Exact clean results: typecheck/build PASS, 13 contracts PASS, prod audit clean, browser E2E PASS with autosave boundary/mobile/reduced-motion/no errors, non-test FIRMES E2E PASS, full suite 153/152 PASS/0 FAIL/1 pre-existing SKIP, runtime 0 forbidden and 0 external symlinks. Release still requires signed host reconciliation.
